author: N6rL
content: Plan: (1) Add serde+serde_json+uuid+thiserror to Cargo.toml deps; (2) src/error.rs — library-level error types; (3) src/raw_document.rs — RawDocument<T> typestate (Unvalidated/Validated), all component types mirroring Python schema v1, deny_unknown_fields on all serde structs, try_from_json() constructor (ADR-003); (4) src/knowledge_object.rs — KnowledgeObjectId newtype, KnowledgeObject struct, Enrichment record; (5) src/library.rs — Library trait, IdentityResult enum (ADR-003: ExactMatch/VersionUpdate/SoftMatch/NewUnique), LibraryQuery; (6) src/projection.rs — Projection trait; (7) src/synthesis.rs — SynthesisService trait, SynthesisConfig, SynthesisArtifact; (8) src/job.rs — Job struct, JobId newtype, JobStatus enum (ADR-004); (9) src/lib.rs — pub mod declarations + re-exports; (10) cargo clippy + cargo test clean.
